Maybe we need this after ongoing beta feature "Personal Mirrors" is released, for example, to avoid cheating in game worlds.
BTW, I found a post that could be merged: https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/unity-layer-constraints-and-documentation

We published documentation about the VRChat SDK's layers earlier this year! Check it out:

https://creators.vrchat.com/worlds/layers/

Thank you for your request!

details:
A documentation page for world layers. With names (in order), short info about their use or recommended use. (Info about custom layers too)

This would be useful for knowing what layers to exclude in mirrors, or just what layers in general can be used without issues. 

Also should include Udon specific notes for custom layers (`LayerMask.NameToLayer`), as user specific names will not work. People have asked why their names won't get anything, so this is why.
title: [Docs] World Layer documentation
